name: linkedin-search-app
description: LinkedIn Dataset Search Engine - React + Vite client, Express + Prisma API, deployable to Vercel

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
